shipped.change: Standfirst leads with residency, not comparison
shipped.hypothesis: Comparison is commoditised; residency is uncontested
shipped.metric: prospects repeat the residency framing back

shipped.change: Price-direction note: frontier falling, budget tier rising
shipped.hypothesis: Correcting our own narrative pre-empts a technical buyer correcting it
shipped.metric: no prospect challenges the falling-price claim

shipped.change: EU host dataset expanded to 9 hosts / 18 offerings
shipped.hypothesis: The only dataset no competitor carries
shipped.metric: a residency query returns a usable answer in every EU variant

shipped.hypothesis: Defending a feature BenchLM does better costs more than cutting it
shipped.metric: no one asks where the indices went

shipped.hypothesis: A decision feed beats a data feed; PPT ships data
shipped.metric: one external consumer calls it — ShopAgentic first
shipped.lesson: Every message opens with a URL returning a real answer.

shipped.change: Offer reworked to free-estimate teaser -> paid audit; guarantee scoped to individuals only
shipped.hypothesis: Preview-over-guarantee removes risk before payment and fits enterprise positioning better than a money-back guarantee
shipped.metric: enterprise prospects (Ryan/agency) engage with the free estimate; no 'guarantee = small vendor' reaction
shipped.lesson: Zero requests. The audit is dead.
shipped.trigger: Daniel Royo: guarantee is an enterprise red flag

shipped.change: Capability-per-dollar: AA Intelligence Index scores + VALUE column + 'cheapest model clearing a capability bar' filter
shipped.hypothesis: Buyers pick on value not price; answering 'cheapest model good enough for my task' closes the gap incumbents can't
shipped.metric: a prospect uses the capability floor on a call; audit recommendations cite it
shipped.lesson: Enabled the product's core sentence; floors still heuristic.
shipped.trigger: cost-performance is now the ranking metric

shipped.change: Re-verification pass (scripts/verify.mjs): provider-grouped checklist + stamp command
shipped.hypothesis: Turning stale 'VERIFIED 22 JUL' badges into 'verified this week' removes the freshness objection
shipped.metric: no prospect questions data freshness on a call; sweep run weekly
shipped.lesson: Caught GLM-5.2, Luna and Terra errors directly. Highest-value build.
shipped.trigger: verified dates read stale to prospects

shipped.change: Field-note capture in Drive (structured sheet) + impact view wiring
shipped.hypothesis: Logged calls compound: month-2 review gets real outcome data instead of recollection
shipped.lesson: 33 notes; this review exists because of it.
shipped.trigger: a16z: field telemetry is the flywheel input

shipped.change: Hero reframed to 'system of record for commerce AI spend'
shipped.hypothesis: Owning a workflow (not 'AI cost tool') sharpens positioning vs horizontal incumbents
shipped.metric: prospects echo the framing back; higher reply rate on outreach
shipped.lesson: Repositioned twice since; never echoed back by a prospect.

shipped.hypothesis: Turning incumbents' visibility-not-decisions weakness into our line wins the comparison
shipped.metric: objection 'why not Ramp' handled without founder scrambling on calls

shipped.hypothesis: An independent verified price record is the asset incumbents can't backfill; also what Kai asked for
shipped.metric: a feed consumer (esp. ShopAgentic) integrates or references it
shipped.lesson: Became the artefact every outreach leads with; Kai asked for it by name.
shipped.trigger: Kai (ShopAgentic): price data is the hard part

shipped.change: Catalogue enrichment + on-site search task profiles
shipped.hypothesis: Speaking exact commerce workloads beats any horizontal tool's generic view
shipped.metric: used in a real audit; resonates on a merchant call
shipped.lesson: Superseded by workload framing within three weeks.

shipped.change: Outreach principle: lead with validated switches, not visibility
shipped.hypothesis: Competing on 'decisions' not 'visibility' avoids the lost fight with CloudZero
shipped.lesson: Never tested; pitch changed before anyone heard it.
